Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

receive verb

be given, be sent

also get, be given, accept, get a letter

classical

Cic. Att. 6.1.1: accēpī tuās litterās
Plin. Ep. 7.21.4: gallīnam ut ā tē missam libenter accēpī

accipiō, accipere, accēpī, acceptum

verb, third conjugation

receive, get, accept

Of letters, gifts, news and payments; of news, accēpimus, “we are told” (Cic. Sen. 60).

Examples

  • accēpī tuās litterās …; quās lēgī libentissimē plēnissimās amōris

    I received your letter …, and read it with the greatest pleasure, so full of affection as it wasCic. Att. 6.1.1

  • gallīnam ut ā tē missam libenter accēpī

    I was glad to receive the hen, as it came from youPlin. Ep. 7.21.4

  • Beneficium dandō accēpit, quī dignō dedit.

    whoever has given to someone deserving has received a kindness in the givingPublil. Sent. B 12

See also receive, give it here!.
